additional_info.subject: RE: 0367313 - ID0367313DC/SI-D/NZ - [QZBSqH] Cable rubbing CRM:00641000583
additional_info.body:
Hi Ferdinand,
Regarding the query, yes, replacing the cable and using a Cable Management System will help minimize the cable rubber from getting damaged by the door edges while opening. It is good practice to avoid rubbing the cable against the housing and to be careful not to press the door against the cable.
Please let me know if you have any further queries. If not, shall we proceed with closing this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
